Fleet restructuring, rent generation and the design of individual transferable fishing quota programs: Empirical evidence from the pacific coast groundfish fishery
abstract: This article characterizes anticipated changes in fleet structure, vessel harvesting activity, and economic performance in the Pacific Coast groundfish fishery under an individual fishing quota management program. Results suggest that the current fleet of 117 vessels will be reduced by roughly 50%-66% to 40—60 vessels, resulting in annual cost savings of $18-$22 million (based on 2004 price and cost estimates). However, cost savings could be significantly less if restrictions on quota trading across vessels are incorporated into the program design. Alternative modes of collecting fees to fund program administration and their impact on fleet size and total fishery value are also studied. We conclude that a program of individual fishing quotas, if carefully designed, can be an attractive alternative for management of the Pacific Coast groundfish fishery.
abstract_zh: 本文刻画了在个体可转让捕捞配额（IFQ）管理计划下，太平洋沿岸底栖鱼类渔业中船队结构、船只捕捞活动和经济绩效的预期变化。结果表明，目前由 117 艘船组成的船队将减少约 50%–66%，降至 40–60 艘，每年可节省成本 1800 万至 2200 万美元（基于 2004 年的价格和成本估计）。然而，如果在计划设计中纳入对船只间配额交易的限制，成本节约可能会显著减少。本文还研究了为计划管理筹措资金的不同收费方式，及其对船队规模和渔业总价值的影响。我们的结论是，若设计得当，个体捕捞配额计划可以成为管理太平洋沿岸底栖鱼类渔业的一种有吸引力的替代方案。

Search and active learning with correlated information: evidence from Mid-Atlantic clam fishermen
venue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
abstract: This paper examines search with active learning and correlated information. We first develop a simple model to show how correlation affects the decision to acquire information. A unique data set on fishing site choice by mid-Atlantic clam fishermen is used to test the model predictions. Results find that clam fishermen search new sites when the catch at familiar sites declines, i.e., when the opportunity cost of gathering information is low, but also when catch at familiar sites is on the rise. Search following a catch decline occurs at spatially distant sites whereas search following a catch increase occurs at nearby sites. Correlated learning is crucial for explaining the site choice patterns in our data. These results provide new insights that may extend to a variety of economic search problems where correlated learning is important.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在信息相关情况下的主动学习式搜寻。我们首先构建一个简单模型，说明信息相关性如何影响获取信息的决策。我们利用中大西洋地区蛤类渔民选择捕捞地点的独特数据集来检验模型预测。结果表明，当熟悉地点的渔获量下降时，即收集信息的机会成本较低时，蛤类渔民会搜寻新的地点；但当熟悉地点的渔获量上升时，他们同样会进行搜寻。渔获量下降后的搜寻发生在空间上较远的地点，而渔获量上升后的搜寻则发生在附近的地点。相关性学习对于解释我们数据中的地点选择模式至关重要。这些结果为解释多种经济搜寻问题提供了新的见解，在相关学习十分重要的各种情境中可能同样适用。

An empirical analysis of production distortions in the Mid-Atlantic surf clam and ocean quahog fishery
abstract: This paper presents empirical evidence of production distortions under controlled access management in the Mid-Atlantic surf clam and ocean quahog fishery. Results indicate that vessels harvested multiple clam species even though the harvest technology exhibits diseconomies of scope. Vessels also operated in a region of the production surface where the marginal product of vessel capital services was negative. These distortions are explained by perverse regulations which restricted vessel capital replacement and severely limited fishing times.
abstract_zh: 本文为中大西洋地区蛤类与海洋硬壳蛤渔业在受控准入管理下存在生产扭曲提供了实证证据。结果表明，尽管捕捞技术呈现范围不经济（diseconomies of scope），但船只仍同时捕捞多种蛤类。此外，船只还在船舶资本服务边际产出为负的生产面上作业。这些扭曲可以由一些不当法规来解释，这些法规限制了船舶资本的更新，并严重限制了捕捞时间。

An Analysis of the Efficient Production Frontier in the Fishery: Implications for Enhanced Fisheries Management
abstract: The transformation relationship between factor inputs and outputs - the efficient production frontier (EPF)- contains important information for fisheries managers. A directional technology distance function model of the harvesting technology is used to measure changes in the EPF over time. Frontier shifts are summarized with input- and output-based frontier indicators that are interpreted as measures of bioeconomic productivity change. The model is applied to the Mid-Atlantic surf clam and ocean quahog fishery.
abstract_zh: 投入要素与产出之间的转换关系，即有效生产前沿（efficient production frontier, EPF），包含了对渔业管理者重要的信息。本文采用捕捞技术的方向性技术距离函数模型，衡量有效生产前沿随时间的变化。前沿的移动通过基于投入和基于产出的前沿指标进行概括，这些指标被解释为生物经济生产率变化的度量。该模型被应用于中大西洋地区蛤类与海洋硬壳蛤渔业。

Assessing Efficiency Gains From Individual Transferable Quotas: An Application to the Mid-Atlantic Surf Clam and Ocean Quahog Fishery
abstract: Delayed fishing fleet restructuring complicates the assessment of efficiency gains from individual transferable quota (ITQ) fisheries management programs. This article presents a methodology to estimate harvest sector efficiency gains in lieu of incomplete fleet restructuring. The methodology is applied to assess the efficiency gains in the Mid-Atlantic surf clam and ocean quahog fishery ITQ program. While roughly 128 vessels harvested clams under the previous management regime, the analysis suggests that 21–25 vessels will remain under ITQs. The efficiency gains are estimated to be between $11.1 million and $12.8 million annually (1990 dollars).
abstract_zh: 渔船队结构调整的延迟，使得评估个体可转让配额（ITQ）渔业管理计划所带来的效率收益变得复杂。本文提出了一种方法，用于在船队结构调整不完全的情况下估计捕捞部门的效率收益。该方法被应用于评估中大西洋地区蛤类与海洋硬壳蛤渔业的 ITQ 计划所带来的效率收益。在之前的管理制度下，约有 128 艘船捕捞蛤类，而分析表明，在 ITQ 制度下仍将有 21–25 艘船保留。效率收益估计每年为 1110 万至 1280 万美元（按 1990 年美元计算）。
